geometry: positive diagonal prescribed Bianchi-I scale factors; gas-comoving tetrad
number_state: characteristic packet photon count per conserved H nucleus
volume_density: nH=nH0/V, N_cMpc3/(a_bar^3*MPC_CM^3), never direction-dependent observed redshift
event_owner: each species hazard integrated at identical energy/time quadrature as photon removal and heating
threshold_rule: find all crossings including reentry; source fit threshold distinct from binding chi
spectral_edge_rule: signed number edge flux plus edge-energy flux and interior redshift work

escape.L: emission-time cumulative energy, not present radiation energy
escape.replace_rule: replace L by e_escape+Wescape; do not add both

momentum: non-tilted model requires zero net radiation force; antipodal symmetry used here
polarization: supplied-U coherency map exp(-tau)*U*F*Udagger; actual screen map not implemented
